## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and its contribution area: Picker, Books & Library, Pack, Desktop App, or Documentation.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Added or updated focused tests where behavior changed

## Privacy and Compatibility

- [ ] No local database, media file, export, credential, or browser storage dump is included
- [ ] API and local-data compatibility impact is documented
